# phasetwo_payment_method (Data Source)

A saved payment method on an organization.

Payment methods are not managed by this provider — add a card in the Phase Two console, then look it up here to pass to `phasetwo_cluster`.

Give either `id`, or `default = true` to take the organization's default card.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Payment methods are referenced, not managed — adding a card is a Stripe browser flow.
data "phasetwo_payment_method" "default" {
  organization_id = data.phasetwo_organization.team.id
  default         = true
}

# Or select a specific card by id.
data "phasetwo_payment_method" "corporate" {
  organization_id = data.phasetwo_organization.team.id
  id              = "pm_1234567890"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization the payment method belongs to.

### Optional

- `default` (Boolean) Set to `true` to select the organization's default payment method. On read, reports whether the selected method is the default.
- `id` (String) ID of the payment method. Set this or `default`.

### Read-Only

- `brand` (String) Card brand.
- `exp_month` (Number) Card expiry month.
- `exp_year` (Number) Card expiry year.
- `in_use_by_active_subscription` (Boolean) Whether an active subscription is using this payment method. One that is in use cannot be removed.
- `last4` (String) Last four digits of the card.
- `type` (String) Payment method type, e.g. `card`.
